guide: Mine normal or Pure Ores in the Dwarven Mines.
You'll want to get as much Mining Speed
and Spread for this as you can.
Pickobulus is another great helper.
Use the best fishing rod, bait and armor that you
have access to and fish in The Park during rain
or in the Backwater Bayou if you want to progress
the Lily Pad Collector Goal alongside.
Recommended are Angler Armor and Fish Bait.
For this you just need to mine blocks,
complete Mining Commissions and collect
occasional Commission Milestones.
Do your daily mining commissions and
participate in active Mining Events.
A higher level Bingo Pet will benefit you here.
Carrots and potatoes from killing
Zombies in graveyard do count.
You can also kill Endermen in the End
for this for more Combat XP.
You'll want to get the highest Looting
and Luck enchant as you can on your weapon
for this for more frequent drops.
You will most likely get this passively.
Use /be ingame to view your progress once you
talked to Bramass Beastslayer in The Spiders Den.
Mine Pure Gold in the Dwarven Mines
with a Fortune 3+ pickaxe.
Use as much Mining Speed/Spread and Fortune
perks from HotM as you can.
You might want to use as many minions
as you have access to for this.
Remember to put a compactor in the minions
when you plan on leaving for a while.
Don't forget to fuel the minions,
give them storages and collect them in time.
Complete a Floor 1 and open the
free chest afterwards.
You might need help with this.
To help with this, try to make bigger crafts
by hand for Carpentry levels.
Also do your daily experiments and make sure
to have a pet active at all times
(any pet works, even level 100).

note: Find 3 Pairs in the Experimentation Table
guide: Get Enchanting Level 10 and play
the first tier in the Experimentation Table.
Optimal tool:
Golden Axe with Efficiency 5
Reforges: Double-Bit or Lush
Get Haste 3 from a splash to instamine wood
You could consider getting gear from
Galatea like Canopy Armor.
Fish in the Hub until you can enter the Backwater Bayou.
Fish there and lootshare mobs until you unlock
Lily Pad Minions or gain access to the Lotus Atoll.
Place as many of them on your island,
as you can and give them the best fuel and storage
you have access to and don't forget to collect in time.
Optimal tool:
Advanced Gardening Axe (25 copper)
Make a full plot of Cocoa Beans (16716 needed
or 105 enchanted) in The Garden (SkyBlock Level 5).
You will need Garden Level 8.
Get the Cocoa Beans to plant from The Desert Island.
Brew an Absorption IV potion
with an Enchanted Gold and combine it with a Glowstone.
You can get that Glowstone by buying one block
from the Builder and breaking it on your island.
This requires Catacombs Level 1 and
a completion of the previous floor.
You may need help from party finder
or friends for this.
The recipe for the Aspect of the End unlocks
at 25k Ender Pearl Collection.
Use Minions or manually kill Endermen in the End
to unlock this. The Blaze Powder for the
Enchanted Eyes of Ender can be bought from
The Alchemist in the Hub.
Reforge your Void Sword to Sharp
at the Blacksmith in the Hub or
enchant any weapon with Critical 5.
Any mob can spawn as Runic, you'll
want to look out for mobs with
a purple name tag.
This unlocks at 2.5k Raw Porkchop Collection
and requires 40 Enchanted Pork to make.
You can use Minions for this, just
remember to give them the best fuel and storage
you have access to and collect in time.
Wear armor enchanted with Growth 5
(Enchanting Level 5), preferably Ender Armor
while you're in The End.
Applying Growth 5 costs 50 Levels each.
If you still struggle, reforge your
armor to Titanic.
Collect those you run along while doing other goals.
If you have trouble check TimeDeo's fairy soul tutorial
on YouTube or use SkyHanni's Fairy Soul Finder.
Talk to Guildford in the Dungeon Hub
and complete 4/4 objectives of 2 races.
Don't forget to talk to Guildford
after each run you do.
Use the wiki to figure out what Fetchur asks for.
You will need to get into Dwarven Mines to be
able to even talk to him.
Craft some easy minions while also getting
those that will help with this Bingo.
Use NPC shops to buy materials for easy crafts.
Ways to obtain:
Craft (Lapis Lazuli Collection 5),
a drop from fishing,
from the Experimentation Table,
drop from Ender Nodes in the End (11-13%).
